summary: ATIF Holdings closed its acquisition of GoldCoin Labs Limited, a BVI developer of gold-backed digital asset issuance infrastructure for the Metra Gold (GOLDM) token, on September 9, 2026, after signing the agreement July 30, 2026. ATIF issued 2,815,005 ordinary shares to GoldCoin's sole shareholder as consideration, valued at approximately $20 million under a five-trading-day VWAP mechanism. Post-closing, 22,128,378 shares are outstanding. The board obtained a fairness opinion from Pinetree Advisory and Valuation Limited and unanimously approved. Watch share overhang from the issuance and lock-up terms.
